import_provenance.original_title: The traversal conjecture for splay trees
import_provenance.original_statement: Starting from any n-key BST, does splaying the keys in the preorder sequence of any other BST on the same keys take O(n) total time? Mehlhorn and coauthors study this fundamental special case through pattern avoidance and obtain relaxations for Greedy.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The statement is specifically about Splay; linear-time results for variants of Greedy with preprocessing do not prove it.
